description.en: Meta, macro and beyond are operators in one framework.

grand.en: Meta, macro and beyond are operators, not slogans.

lead.en: W5D creates meta, macro and beyond technology. The phrase is an ontological programme: technology is structured, scaled and generated.

text.en: Technology is commonly treated as a neutral instrument or as a self-generating force. W5D holds both views to be inadequate. Technology is structured, scaled and generated, and the three words name those three conditions.

The layer at which a system becomes aware of its own structure. Its institution is MetaX Academy, built on one constraint: every substantive claim carries what a stranger needs in order to find out that it is wrong. In operation it is the fourth dimension, Information/Structure.

Technology understood as a large-scale ensemble rather than an isolated artefact: a macrosystem. Its institution is MacroLifeTech (Meta-X), a research-preview umbrella. In operation it is the fifth dimension, Possibility/Modality, extended across large-scale systems.

The layer of creators, conditions and intelligences from which technology emerges. It is an ontological claim about priority: technology is a dependent entity and does not self-originate. It is neither a spatial nor a temporal beyond. BCIA is the first research programme from the beyond.
To create technology without meta is to create blindly, without macro to create parochially, and without beyond to create idolatrously.

source.en: The official wording of meta, macro and beyond

body.en: The mapping of meta to the fourth dimension and macro to the fifth is the W5D mapping. Other mappings exist in the wider literature and are not adopted here.

text.en: Each layer has an institution, and each institution has a dated status.
